# 1 Clement Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** God's grace was entrusted to his servants, and they spoke by the Holy Spirit about repentance.

**8:2** The Sovereign Lord himself swore an oath about repentance: "As I live, says the Lord, I have no desire for the sinner's death — only for his repentance." And he added these gracious words: [Ezek 33:11]

**8:3** "House of Israel, turn back from your wickedness. Say this to my people: Even if your sins pile up from the earth to the sky, even if they are redder than scarlet and blacker than sackcloth — if you turn to me with your whole heart and call me 'Father,' I will hear you as my holy people." [composite citation]

**8:4** And in another place he says: "Wash and be clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight. Stop doing evil. Learn to do good. Seek justice. Help the oppressed. Defend the orphan. Take up the widow's cause. Come, let us reason this out together, says the Lord. If your sins are crimson, I will make them white as snow. If they are scarlet, I will make them white as wool. If you are willing and obey me, you will feast on the good things of the land. But if you refuse and rebel, the sword will devour you — for the mouth of the Lord has spoken it." [Isa 1:16-20]

---

*PNEUMA renders Isaiah 1 with full rhetorical force.*
